name: Xinte Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinte Energy Co., Ltd. engages in the construction of wind power and PV power plants in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It operates through Polysilicon; Construction of Wind Power and PV Power Plants; Operation of Wind Power and PV Power Plants; Electrical Equipment; and Others segment.
